change_note: 2026.2-MK: Marschkamp's BIA method as its twenty finished BIA records apply it. 5 impact categories (Health of persons; Financial; Legal; Image; Operational), 7 time horizons (1 h to 168 h), a five-level scale (none 1, low 2, medium 3, high 4, very high 5) and intolerability threshold 4. The records hold no per-level definitions, so the scale carries labels only. RPO vocabulary as the records' RPO column writes it. Human read-back mirror: impact-criteria.md.
mtpd_rule: MTPD = the earliest time horizon at which the worst-case rating across the categories reaches intolerability threshold 4 (high). A grid that reaches it in no horizon has no MTPD within the horizons, which is what '>168 h' means.
rto_rule: The RTO is the process owner's decision in the interview, recorded as stated; it is not derived from the grid.
